'''Jaxson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the same time as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Jaxson had Imperial sympathies, but failed his entrance exam to the academy.

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> he and Skywalker had a [[Skyhopper/Legends|Skyhopper]] race due to Jaxson's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] beliefs and Skywalker's [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ones. In the race, Jaxson fell behind Skywalker. Just before Skywalker was about to attempt to go through the [[Stone Needle/Legends|Stone Needle]], both of their skyhopper's electrical systems were wiped out by a [[Active sensor pulse generator|pulse generator]] put in the area by the bounty hunter [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], who was capturing Skywalker for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="Renegade" />

Bossk took them into a cave in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] to spend the night. There, Luke freed Jaxson and himself with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. They attempted to escape in Bossk's speeder, but Bossk woke up and attacked Luke. In the fight, Bossk lost an arm and a leg. Luke tried to get to the speeder to escape with Jaxson, but Bossk threw a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|Fragmentation grenade]] into the speeder. Jaxson and Luke survived the explosion, and Bossk declared that they would die together. Jaxson and Luke escaped into the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="Renegade" />

There, Jaxson and Luke encountered a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] tribe, but Luke scared them away with a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] call. Jaxson later saved Luke from falling off a cliff. Once they were rescued by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who was on Tatooine with Luke, they were no longer enemies due to the fact that they had both saved each others life. They later participated in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] shootout.<ref name="Renegade" />
